name: Divine Light, Lesser
body:
School evocation; Level adept 0, cleric/oracle 0, inquisitor 0, white necromancer 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Target one living or undead creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You envelop the target a shining radiance dealing 1d3 positive energy damage to the target if they are a living creature, or 1d6 positive energy damage if the creature is undead. This has no effect on constructs or objects. A successful Reflex save halves this damage.
